definitions.explanation: Describes a sudden loss of energy or spirits due to disappointment or shock. Often accompanied by physical drooping of the shoulders or head.
Describes a sudden physical weakening or giving way, such as knees buckling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧がっくり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was dejected after failing the exam.
He dropped his shoulders in disappointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧がっくり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was dejected when I heard the results.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期待|きたい}していた→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、がっくり⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The shop I'd been looking forward to was closed, and I was hit with disappointment.

examples.japanese: ⟦せっかく→折角：04361_sekkaku⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦のに→のに：10529_noni⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧がっくり⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even though we had prepared, it was canceled, and everyone was dejected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧。
⟦{疲|つか}れて→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My legs gave out from exhaustion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}ったら→上る：21460_noboru⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After climbing the long staircase, my body gave out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦あと→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}に→急に：00263_kyuuni⟧⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: After the illness, my stamina dropped suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がろうとしたら→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくりときて、⟦{倒|たお}れそうになった→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: When I tried to stand up, my knees buckled and I almost fell over.

notes:
がっくり conveys a sudden, visible loss of spirits or physical strength. It often implies a bodily reaction — shoulders drooping, knees buckling — rather than just an internal feeling.

SENSE 1 - EMOTIONAL DEJECTION:
- がっくり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to feel dejected, crestfallen
- がっくり⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to be hit with disappointment
- ⟦{肩|かた}→肩：02192_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧がっくり⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to drop one's shoulders in despair

SENSE 2 - PHYSICAL WEAKENING:
- ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: knees give way
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧がっくり⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: stamina drops sharply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦がっかり→がっかり：00054_gakkari⟧: disappointed (similar but less physical, more internal)
- ⟦しょんぼり→しょんぼり：05834_shonbori⟧: dejected, downcast (quieter, more passive sadness)
- ⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}む→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧: to feel down (longer-lasting low mood)
